title: H3 AI Influencer (upscaled)
description: One character kept the same from shot to shot, from up to five reference images, motion videos and audio, then upscaled with RealESRGAN to the output size.

labels.1:value: Say what happens. Refer to your references as <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>.
labels.22:image: Character 2: another angle, or a second person (<Picture 2>)
labels.18:image: First frame (the video starts on this image; empty = text to video)
labels.19:image: Last frame (the video ends on this image)
labels.6:value: Upscale to the output size (off = native 768p)

choices.label: Reference mode
choices.hint: The character, location, outfit, motion videos and audio guide a new scene.

choices.label: First-frame mode
choices.hint: Animates the first frame as it is. With no first frame it is text to video.

confirm.message: A long video continues each clip from the last frame of the one before, which only first-frame mode reads. In reference mode every clip starts fresh.

hints: Refer to your references in the prompt: <Picture 1> is character 1, <Picture 3> location 1, <Video 1> the first motion video.
Character 1 is the one that matters most: a sharp, well-lit picture of the face and the full look.
Upscaling to 2560 x 1080 or 3840 x 2160 adds time after the render. Turn it off for drafts.
5-6 s clips keep the character most consistent.
